# `jouet wind adopt`

- **Usage:** `jouet wind adopt <ID>`

Mark a review's proposal or a memory note as dealt with

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`** — The id of a note (n3), a proposal (p2), a suggested review (r1), a mise task (t1) or a memory note (m1)
